children: Tesco and Sainsbury's buybacks for fiscal 2027 are moving faster than a linear pace, J.P. Morgan analysts say in a note. Tesco is nearly three-quarters of the way through its buyback with around seven months left, the analysts said. Both U.K. grocers will be able to top up buybacks while staying within their ideal leverage ranges, the analysts add. Of the two, an upgrade is more likely for Tesco. If its buybacks continue at current pace, they will likely conclude ahead of schedule, the analysts say. Tesco shares are down 0.86% at 475.40 pence. (aimee.look@wsj.com)
